page_title: VER 0-1 ACM | Verona v AC Milan 19/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Al Musrati (Verona) horribly skewed a first-time shot from the edge of the box and sent the ball way wide of the right post.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

90' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
84' Al Musrati (Verona) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
84' Rafik Belghali (Verona) is about to take a corner kick.
84' Gift Orban (Verona) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gift Orban (Verona) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
83' A substitution has been made. Roberto Gagliardini goes off and Sandi Lovric (Verona) comes on.
82' Paolo Sammarco decides to make a substitution. Antoine Bernede will be replaced by Isaac (Verona).
80' It will be a substitution. Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) is ready to enter the pitch as Christian Pulisic walks off.
75' The referee signals a corner kick to Verona.
75' The goal by Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) has been disallowed after the referee checked with the video assistant referee!
75' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) puts the ball into the back of the net, but referee Daniele Chiffi immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
70' Ooh that was close! Ioan Vermesan (Verona) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
68' Verona will take a corner kick.
68' Rafik Belghali (Verona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Al Musrati (Verona) will replace Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro.
64' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Samuele Ricci.
63' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Zachary Athekame and he is replaced by Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan).
63' The substitution has been made. Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) has replaced Rafael Leao.
62' The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.
53' Rafik Belghali (Verona) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
51' Rafik Belghali (Verona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
46' Paolo Sammarco makes a half-time substitution. Ioan Vermesan (Verona) comes on in place of Domagoj Bradaric.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' Rafik Belghali (Verona) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Mike Maignan guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

41' 0 - 1 Goal! Rafael Leao plays in Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 0:1.
35' Gift Orban (Verona) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.

33' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for an infringement. Verona are awarded the free kick.
31' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo made a easy save.

26' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) unleashed a poor free kick shot from far out. He intended to threaten the goalkeeper, but instead sent the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
24' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
21' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) is being substituted because of an injury. Paolo Sammarco sends Pol Lirola on the pitch.
19' It doesn’t look good for Daniel Oyegoke (Verona); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
18' The game is interrupted now, Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
13' Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
11' Wasted opportunity! Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
9' Antoine Bernede (Verona) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
7' Verona are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Verona will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Chiffi.
